LESSON: VISUAL PROGRAMMING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Communication in Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 2.4: Visual Programming

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Visual Programming. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How are computer programs used in day-to-day life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify types of visual programming applications used in day-to-day life
2. create instructions to solve problems using visual programming application
3. value the importance of visual programming in day- to-day life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: VISUAL PROGRAMMING
This lesson teaches Visual Programming for Grade 8 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify types of visual programming applications used in day-to-day life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. create instructions to solve problems using visual programming application
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. value the importance of visual programming in day- to-day life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Visual Programming using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Visual Programming above.
2. Explain Visual Programming to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Visual Programming.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Visual Programming with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Visual Programming important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are computer programs used in day-to-day life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify types of visual programming applications used in day-to-day life
2. create instructions to solve problems using visual programming application
3. value the importance of visual programming in day- to-day life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
